```{r setup-alex, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(stringr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringr))
source('reveal.R')

# descriptive titles, kept in step with exercises.Rmd
ex_text <- c(": Getting to know R and RStudio", ": Basic R operations",
             ": Importing and inspecting data",
             ": Manipulating and summarising dataframes",
             ": Visualising data using base R",
             ": Graphics for communication",
             ": Reproducible reports with R markdown",
             ": Version control with Git and GitHub")

sol_links <- function(n) {
  paste0("- [Exercise ", n, " solutions", ex_text[n], "](exercise_", n,
         "_solution.html){target='_blank'}")
}
```

\  

Follow the links below for solutions to each of the exercises you have completed on this course. Click on the 'code' buttons to reveal the R code associated with each question. If you would prefer these solutions as R scripts for later offline use then you can [find these here](course_code.html).

#### PDF versions of exercise solutions

\  

[Offline R scripts](course_code.html)

```{r code-out, include = FALSE}
# TODO: generate list automagically
# Chunk options in the solution files are written as eval=SOLUTIONS / echo=SOLUTIONS,
# and their setup chunks are purl = FALSE, so purl() cannot see SOLUTIONS unless we
# define it here. Without this the purled scripts come out empty.
SOLUTIONS <- TRUE
for (i in 1:8) {
  knitr::purl(paste0('./exercise_', i, '_solution.Rmd'),
              output = paste0('./exercise_solutions/exercise_', i, '_solution.R'), quiet = TRUE)
}
# knitr::purl('./exercise_5_ggplot_solution.Rmd', output = './exercise_solutions/exercise_5_ggplot_solution.R', quiet = TRUE)
knitr::purl('./exercise_programming_solution.Rmd', output = './exercise_solutions/exercise_programming_solution.R', quiet = TRUE)
```
